listing.name: Dynasty Warriors: Gundam 2 — DWG2Recomp (Adeelshah001)
listing.summary: Research project. Alpha: music interruptions, crashes, FOV/HUD defects and incomplete save testing. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Dynasty Warriors: Gundam 2 Xbox 360 disc ISO. USA only; modified/other-region images unsupported.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the v0.3-alpha player ZIP and use START_DWG2.exe to import your own USA ISO. The source archive is a separate download.

warnings: Alpha: music interruptions, crashes, FOV/HUD defects and incomplete save testing.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
